description: Source-grounded template for audience-specific practical handbooks with edition, provenance, evidence, and copyright controls.
when_to_load: When a supplied or reliably identified source must become a practical audience-specific handbook.
when_not_to_load: Do not load when the source cannot be identified and the user expects source-faithful detail, or for direct source implementation.
do_not_regress: Keep source access mode and exact edition or version identity explicit.
Distinguish source-derived material, user-provided notes, modern commentary, implementation suggestions, and unknowns.
Do not invent chapters, quotations, citations, page references, or current practices.
Keep synthesis copyright-safe and avoid reconstructing a substitute copy of the source.
Do not force a fixed handbook structure when source coverage or user need does not support it.
Delegate implementation, package, terminal, validation evidence, and freeze authority.
